remarks: Charming center hall four square colonial with modern amenities. The large front porch welcomes you into the home with detailed moldings, 9'+ soaring ceilings, hardwood floors throughout and tons of natural light. Foyer opens to family room/den, formal dining area, expansive living room and kithcen with new Viking gas stove and microwave. Semi-finished basement with CT Basement waterproofing, bonus rec room/gym and washer/dryer. New natural gas HVAC/Central Air and tankless hot water heater. Upstairs boasts 3 large bedroom, 2 newly renovated full baths and new carpeting on the stairs and landing. Lots of storage in walk-up unfinished attic. Outside you can relax in the fully fenced-in private, level yard. 1 car detached garage and ample parking. Walk to train, shopping and restaurants at the new Darien Commons and Heights Crossing. Tenant responsible for credit check, first months rent and two months security (one month if 62 or older) due at signing of lease and all utilities, electric, natural gas, cable/internet, lawn maintainence, snow plowing, trash/recyling and personal property and liability insurance. Pets are welcome! Available immediately.
